caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man with light skin, blue eyes, and short, wavy gray hair. The bust is shown from the upper chest up and features the man draped in a grayish-blue cloth that wraps around his shoulders and chest in deep folds. The base of the bust is a brown sculpted pedestal with scroll-like decorative elements. The background is plain and uncolored, with the image set against an off-white or light beige paper. The composition centers the bust, and the colors primarily consist of natural skin tones, grayish-blue for the drapery, brown for the pedestal, and subtle shading to suggest form and dimension.
title: Figurehead: Bust of Washington
